name_input: PUSH UP TOOLS UDYOG P LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey page for PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PVT LTD (201, I.D.COLONY HISSAR ROAD) shows 3764 records, but every visible row is an IMPORT into India, e.g. "2026-02-28 PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PVT LTD DIPL-ING FRITZ LICHTHART BETRIEBSGE THREAD ROLLING DIES ... DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, GERMANY 82072000 1110003" — origin is India only because the Indian party is the consignee/supplier column; destination is the foreign port, i.e. goods arriving FROM Germany. Second page (PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PRIVATE LIMITED, Plot No 35 Sector 31B Phase-1 HSIIDC IMT Rohtak) shows 299 records, latest 2025-11-27, all likewise inbound: "2025-11-27 FUJI DIE CO LIMITED PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PRIVATE LIMITED TUNGSTEN CARBIDE TIPS/INSERT JAPAN DELHI AIR, India 82090090 1520596". No outbound (India-origin) bill of lading with a foreign consignee was found in the free views; volza, eximpedia, trademo and importgenius returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused), so export side could not be independently confirmed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split was retrievable: search engine returned no results (searx connection refused) and eximpedia/trademo/volza blocked (HTTP 403). Only indirect domestic-market signal: the company appears as a buyer of tooling from Indian-linked counterparties and as a supplier name in Indian customs counterparty lists (e.g. "PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PVT LTD, KADIMI TOOL MANUFACTURING COMPANY PRIVATE LIMITED, PLOT NO 35 SECTOR-31B PHASE-1"), which indicates an operating manufacturing address in HSIIDC IMT Rohtak / Hisar Road but is not a supply record.
note: Two distinct legal entities/addresses appear in customs data: PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PVT LTD (201, I.D. Colony, Hisar Road) with 3764 records and PUSH-UP TOOLS UDYOG PRIVATE LIMITED (Plot 35, Sector 31B, Phase-1, HSIIDC IMT Rohtak) with 299 records — likely the same group, but the claimed name 'PUSH UP TOOLS UDYOG P LTD' matches neither exactly. Declared HS 820740 (thread-rolling dies / tools for tapping or threading) is consistent with the imported/exported product description 'THREAD ROLLING DIES PARTS ACCESSORIES (BRAZED CARBIDE TOOLS)' seen under HS 82072000, so the HS family is plausible; note the customs rows themselves carry 82072000, not 820740. IMPORTANT: the 3764/299 shipment counts are IMPORT records (raw material: tungsten carbide tips/inserts from Fuji Die Japan, Hunan Boyun Dongfang China, Wan Iuan Taiwan; EDM filter elements from Suzhou Everich). They prove the company is an active, real operating buyer with dated customs entries up to 2026-02-28, but they do NOT prove export shipments. No export bill of lading with date, destination and B/L number was located in accessible sources; export status therefore 'declared_only' (product catalogue/website claims not treated as fact). Revenue and export volume: null — not public in accessible sources. Domestic supply evidence: none found beyond the operating-address signal; no GST band or tender award retrieved. Source counter: 2 importkey pages read, 10 shipment rows actually seen (5 + 5), 0 export rows seen.
